judge.rationale: The candidate implementation is functionally sound and accurately sums token usage across tool rounds while handling missing round usage and completely unreported turns properly. To clarify the hook signature, the candidate introduced a structurally identical `AggregateUsage` interface in `src/types/ai.ts`, whereas the reference simply renamed the parameter to `totalUsage?: UsageMetadata`. However, doing so led the candidate to edit the type annotation in the existing no-tool test in `src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts`, slightly violating the acceptance criterion that the existing test remain unedited (as well as leaving its own `.lore/dod.md` artifact in the diff). Additionally, the candidate placed new tests in a separate acceptance test file rather than alongside existing tool loop tests, and missed updating the doc-block in `specs/hal-engine-architecture/spec.md` and `CLAUDE.md`.
